# External

`XiToken/` is the C# library from https://github.com/rubymatrix/xitoken (`dotnet/XiToken`, commit c2c7d8c, MIT; see
`XiToken/LICENSE`): signed short-lived tokens, key sets, registries and the gateway client this lobby uses for
federated worlds (see `Federation.cs`). Update it by copying that folder from the repo; tests and vectors live there.
